headline: ICBC President Says Commercial Lenders Bear Heavier AI Burden Than Central Banks
summary: Industrial and Commercial Bank of China president Liu Jun stated that commercial lenders face direct financial and legal liability during the AI transition compared to central banks.
why: ICBC is the world's largest commercial bank by assets, making its executive commentary influential regarding banking technology adoption.

entities.name: Industrial and Commercial Bank of China

impacts.name: Banking
impacts.why: Adopting artificial intelligence creates operational expenditures and liability challenges for financial institutions.
